title: Design System: Mail Indexer and Searcher

body.purpose: Core reading, previews, and supporting copy.

label.purpose: Form labels, sender names, and compact controls.

shadows.name: control-low
shadows.purpose: Observed low elevation on the native folder selector.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Quick tonal response on interactive email rows and controls.

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Dark, labeled search control for sender, subject, and message content.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #e5e5e5; font: 500 14px/1.25 Instrument Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input-search { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; border: 1px solid #404040; border-radius: 12px; background: #171717; color: #fafafa; padding: 10px 12px; font: 400 14px/1.5 Instrument Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input-search::placeholder { color: #a3a3a3; } .ds-input-search:hover { border-color: #525252; } .ds-input-search:focus-visible { border-color: #fafafa; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #171717, 0 0 0 4px #fafafa; }

components.name: Email List Container
components.description: The raised, border-defined container for search results.
components.html: Search resultsMessages are grouped in a single scanning surface.
components.css: .ds-email-list { display: grid; gap: 8px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #262626; border-radius: 16px; background: #171717; padding: 20px; color: #fafafa; font: 400 14px/1.5 Instrument Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-email-list strong { font-weight: 600; } .ds-email-list span { color: #a3a3a3; }

components.name: Email Result Row
components.description: A compact, full-width row that makes sender and subject easy to scan.
components.css: .ds-email-row { display: grid; width: 100%; gap: 4px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #262626; background: #171717; padding: 16px 20px; color: #fafafa; text-align: left; font-family: Instrument Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-email-row:hover, .ds-email-row:focus-visible { background: rgba(38, 38, 38, 0.6); outline: none; } .ds-email-from { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-email-subject { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-email-preview { color: #d4d4d4; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-email-row time { color: #a3a3a3; font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Folder Chip
components.description: Muted metadata label for a message folder.
components.css: .ds-folder-chip { display: inline-flex; width: fit-content; border-radius: 999px; background: #262626; padding: 4px 10px; color: #d4d4d4; font: 400 12px/1.25 Instrument Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Attachment Chip
components.description: Bordered metadata label for the number of message attachments.
components.css: .ds-attachment-chip { display: inline-flex; width: fit-content; align-items: center; gap: 4px; border: 1px solid #404040; border-radius: 999px; background: #171717; padding: 4px 10px; color: #d4d4d4; font: 500 12px/1.25 Instrument Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: High-contrast compact action based on the existing Flux accent behavior.
components.css: .ds-primary-button { border: 1px solid #fafafa; border-radius: 6px; background: #fafafa; padding: 8px 12px; color: #171717; font: 500 14px/1.25 Instrument Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-primary-button:hover { border-color: #e5e5e5; background: #e5e5e5; } .ds-primary-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fafafa; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-primary-button:active { background: #d4d4d4; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: Compact sidebar destination with a recognizable icon and concise label.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 10px; color: #d4d4d4; font: 500 14px/1.25 Instrument Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.75; } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { background: #262626; color: #fafafa; outline: none; }

narrative.overview:
The system is a dark-first workspace for an individual developer moving quickly through personal mail. Its quiet zinc surfaces and compact, familiar controls put attention on the message list, search state, and reading task—not decoration.

The visual language is deliberately developer-oriented: dense enough for sustained use, but ordered enough to scan sender, subject, folder, attachments, and time at a glance. It has no brand assets or expressive palette to preserve; contrast, spacing, and state changes carry hierarchy.
keyCharacteristics: Required dark appearance with a near-black workspace and graphite surface hierarchy.
Compact information density with a dependable 4px-derived spacing rhythm.
Border-led grouping, with restrained tonal elevation for active and interactive states.
Instrument Sans typography with weight and scale—not display treatments—creating hierarchy.

rules.name: The Dark-First Rule
rules.body: Dark mode is the required default; light styles are compatibility states, not the product's primary visual experience.

rules.name: The Tonal Signal Rule
rules.body: Use the zinc ramp to distinguish structure and interaction. Do not introduce decorative color as a substitute for clear hierarchy.

rules.name: The Scan-First Rule
rules.body: Sender and subject carry the strongest type weight in email rows; preview text and metadata must remain visually subordinate.

rules.name: The Border Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate workspace regions with a zinc border and surface shift first; use shadows only when an interactive control needs a small tactile lift.

dos: Do default every new surface to the dark `zinc-900`/`zinc-950` workspace family.
Do preserve the sender → subject → preview → metadata reading order in message lists.
Do use the established 8px, 12px, 16px, 20px, and 24px spacing increments.
Do use a tonal hover or focus state on interactive rows and controls.
donts: Don't add brand colors, gradients, or decorative imagery to compensate for missing hierarchy.
Don't use large display typography or oversized controls in operational mail views.
Don't use pronounced card shadows where a zinc border and surface shift communicate containment.
Don't treat light mode as the primary design target.
